title: ESPIG Annual Progress Report: Somalia - Puntland (GPE001325)
publisher: Global Partnership for Education; grant agent UNICEF
why_not: Describes the Puntland EMIS only as the annual data collection from 1,223 facilities (908 primary) and its yearbook, a census; it says the system runs on an external proprietary product the ministry does not fully control, but states nothing on learner records, attendance entry or paper registers.
